parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that a randomly chosen student is at Canton college and prefers hockey.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Find the probability that a randomly chosen student is at Devar college given that he prefers
soccer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
One of the students is chosen at random. Determine whether the events ‘the student prefers
hockey’ and ‘the student is at Amos college or Benn college’ are independent, justifying your
answer.

stem-and-leaf diagram.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Find the median and the interquartile range for machine A. 
It is given that for machine B the median is 0.232 m, the lower quartile is 0.224 m and the upper
quartile is 0.243 m.

4 Trees in the Redian forest are classified as tall, medium or short, according to their height. The heights
can be modelled by a normal distribution with mean 40 m and standard deviation 12 m. Trees with a
height of less than 25 m are classified as short.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Find the probability that a randomly chosen tree is classified as short. 
Of the trees that are classified as tall or medium, one third are tall and two thirds are medium.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Show that the probability that a randomly chosen tree is classified as tall is 0.298, correct to
3 decimal places.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Find the height above which trees are classified as tall.

text: A fair three-sided spinner has sides numbered 1, 2, 3. A fair five-sided spinner has sides numbered
1, 1, 2, 2, 3. Both spinners are spun once. For each spinner, the number on the side on which it
lands is noted. The random variable X is the larger of the two numbers if they are different, and their
common value if they are the same.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Find the number of different ways in which the 10 letters of the word SUMMERTIME can be
arranged so that there is an E at the beginning and an E at the end.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Find the number of different ways in which the 10 letters of the word SUMMERTIME can be
arranged so that the Es are not together.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Four letters are selected from the 10 letters of the word SUMMERTIME. Find the number of
different selections if the four letters include at least one M and exactly one E.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Find the probability that for a random sample of 12 days Moena messages Pasha on no more
than 9 days.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Moena messages Pasha on 1 January. Find the probability that the next day on which she
messages Pasha is 5 January.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Use an approximation to find the probability that in any period of 100 days Moena messages
Pasha on fewer than 64 days.
